|lore=Nicknamed for rodent-like appearance. Delivers orders and sensitive documents. Retractable manipulator arms. Made by Rebaxan Colmuni. Easily frightened.
|game_text=Deploy on any character targeted by an Utinni Effect. Move 'mouse' droid, instead of that character, to pick up Utinni Effect and bring back to be fulfilled or canceled. Landspeed = 3. Upon delivery, 'mouse' droid returns to your hand.
|joke=The lore ends "Easily frightened.", and [[Wookiee Roar]] can "Scare off (lose) one 'mouse' droid on table", as Chewbacca's roar sends a mouse droid racing away on the Death Star in ''Star Wars''.<ref name="wook-g7">[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/MSE-6-G735Y MSE-6-G735Y], Wookieepedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260124100120/https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/MSE-6-G735Y Internet Archive], 24 January 2026.</ref> It is part of the running gag of cards that print alien speech and sounds without a translation.
